title: Impact of Surge in COVID-19 Infections amongst Bus Drivers on Public Bus Transport
what_it_is: Impact of Surge in COVID-19 Infections amongst Bus Drivers on Public Bus Transport

sections.label: Bus captain infection contingency plans
sections.summary: Infected bus captains are under 5% of the population, and contingency plans including longer headways and more double-deck buses will keep essential bus services running.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Due to high vaccination and booster rates, as well as tight safe management measures, infected bus captains, or BCs, account for less than 5% of the total BC population.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: If we face a large increase in the number of infected BCs, the contingency plans will be activated to ensure that essential bus services continue to operate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: And this includes lengthening of bus service headways, starting with low demand bus services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Some of these plans have already been implemented, with about 90 bus services experiencing increased waiting times of not more than three minutes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Where possible, LTA and the bus operators will also deploy more double-deck buses for services with higher loading.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: If not, this would be something LTA might want to consider, moving forth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We do have a group of recently retired and also former BCs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As Ms Pereira is aware, we are trying to increase the number of local BCs by reaching out to more individuals to join us, to take on this important and meaningful role, to be part of the public transport workforce.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: At the same time, we know that it is not easy to train a BC, because it takes time.
